articles.summary: Digital transformation is the process of using digital technologies to change or create new business processes, customer experiences, and culture to meet changing business and market requirements. It’s not a one-time thing. It’s a business strategy that, once established, should continue to change and be refined to stay ahead of ever-changing business trends, climates, and competition.
articles.title: Enabling Digital Transformation: It’s Never “Done”
